am writing to formally complain about the way I was treated during a phone call to the surgery on 4 March.

I contacted the practice because I have been feeling unwell and am currently experiencing severe hair loss and a significant facial skin condition. I was hoping to receive guidance or arrange an appointment. I understand that the phone lines can be busy, and I was patient while waiting on hold.

However, when my call was answered by the receptionist, Fiona, I found her manner to be extremely rude and aggressive. Instead of calmly explaining the process for booking an appointment or directing me to the appropriate online link, she repeatedly interrupted me and did not allow me to explain the symptoms I am experiencing.

When I politely asked her to speak kindly so that I could explain my situation clearly, she continued to talk over me. I felt she was raising her voice and being dismissive. When I asked for her name, she responded in a confrontational manner and spelled it out abruptly. She also accused me of shouting, which I strongly disagree with, as I was simply trying to explain my concerns.

I found the entire interaction very upsetting and unprofessional. As a patient who has attended the practice multiple times, I feel disappointed by the lack of support I have received, both during this call and previously when trying to arrange appointments.

I would appreciate it if this matter could be looked into, as patients should be treated with respect and understanding, especially when they are seeking medical help.",null,[0,108]]]],[null,null,null,null,null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/1118659668336343197/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRGTTFveWRHeGhhMDUyV1hwUk1GSXhWbXhPUjBwcVVXMVJlRTFzUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/1118659668336343197/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRGTTFveWRHeGhhMDUyV1hwUk1GSXhWbXhPUjBwcVVXMVJlRTFzUlJBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/1118659668336343197/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRGTTFveWRHeGhhMDUyV1hwUk1GSXhWbXhPUjBwcVVXMVJlRTFzUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/1118659668336343197/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRGTTFveWRHeGhhMDUyV1hwUk1GSXhWbXhPUjBwcVVXMVJlRTFzUlJBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/1118659668336343197/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRGTTFveWRHeGhhMDUyV1hwUk1GSXhWbXhPUjBwcVVXMVJlRTFzUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/1118659668336343197/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMnRGTTFveWRHeGhhMDUyV1hwUk1GSXhWbXhPUjBwcVVXMVJlRTFzUlJBQhAA"]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tFM1oydGxha052WXpRMFIxVmxOR0pqUW1ReE1sRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xea599417940aab06!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOkE3Z2tlakNvYzQ0R1VlNGJjQmQxMlE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tFM1oydGxha052WXpRMFIxVmxOR0pqUW1ReE1sRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjRvb2Vw7eTAxWpIGMBHRohGCUQoykIDSgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjRvb2Vw7eTAxWpIGMBHRohGCUQ0pMFCAsoAw"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCQnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDVITlVOR2JWOWZSV2hCUW5oQ2EyczBSR1IxUmt4MFNGSmxaMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpRYjBOWk1HSnJTVmRaV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pCUU1HMUlPSGxHVDJJeGRIWnJXWGxqWTJSeUxXYxAB",["0x0:0xea599417940aab06",null,1772616241973305,1772616241973305,[null,null,["https://www.go
